description: This file defines a custom annotation `AllowLeadingOrTrailingWhitespace` used in the OpenMRS project to indicate that a method allows strings with whitespace at the beginning or end. It includes metadata annotations for Java annotations (such as `@Target`, `@Retention`, `@Inherited`, `@Documented`) and references the `OpenmrsObjectSaveHandler` class.

classes.name: AllowLeadingOrTrailingWhitespace
classes.description: A custom annotation indicating that the method permits leading and trailing whitespace in string parameters.
